categories.name: Personal Account Information
categories.definition: Requests for information about personal accounts, finances, bills, or application statuses.

categories.name: Personal Account Management
categories.definition: Requests to perform an action related to personal accounts, finances, or applications, including disputes or service requests.

categories.name: Scheduling & Reminders
categories.definition: Requests to set, check, or manage alarms, timers, reminders, or calendar events and lists.

categories.name: Navigation & Transportation
categories.definition: Requests for directions, estimated travel times, traffic information, ride-hailing, or to share/find location.

categories.name: Media & Entertainment
categories.definition: Requests to play music or video, identify songs, tell jokes, or provide general entertainment.

categories.name: General Knowledge & Facts
categories.definition: Requests for factual information, definitions, conversions, or general questions not related to personal accounts or specific actions.

categories.name: How-To & Troubleshooting
categories.definition: Requests for instructions, troubleshooting steps, or advice on how to perform a task or solve a problem.

categories.name: Assistant Settings & Information
categories.definition: Questions about the assistant itself, its capabilities, or requests to change its settings or behavior.

categories.name: Shopping & Product Information
categories.definition: Requests for product recommendations, where to buy, pricing, product details, or order tracking.

categories.name: Food & Recipes
categories.definition: Requests for meal ideas, recipes, ingredients, cooking instructions, or restaurant suggestions.

categories.name: Reservations & Availability
categories.definition: Requests to check availability, make, confirm, or cancel reservations for places, services, or meeting rooms.

categories.name: Device & System Control
categories.definition: Requests to control device functions, smart home devices, or system processes.

categories.name: Communication
categories.definition: Requests to send messages, make calls, or dictate text.

categories.name: Travel Planning & Logistics
categories.definition: Requests for travel-specific information like flight details, travel advisories, or booking arrangements.

categories.name: Social & Feedback
categories.definition: General social greetings, expressions of gratitude, or feedback about the assistant's performance or a previous action.

categories.name: Utility & Games
categories.definition: Requests for simple interactive tools like coin flips, dice rolls, or other basic games.
